d.title: The World of Work
d.summary: Education, training, the classroom and learning tools, subjects and studying, jobs, careers, skills and the workplace.
subtopics: Education: institutions, training, classroom, learning tools, subjects and studying
Work: jobs and careers, skills and qualifications, applications and the workplace
grammar: Present and future time frames for study and career planning
Masdar patterns and expressions of ability, obligation and preference
Conditional sentences for choices and consequences
Relative clauses, active/passive participles and job descriptions
كان and إنّ families in formal connected language
Formal question forms and accurate interview responses

skills.Listening: School information, course guidance, interviews and workplace conversations
skills.Reading: Timetables, course descriptions, job adverts, profiles and application information
skills.Speaking: Discuss education, compare routes, explain ambitions and respond in an interview
skills.Writing: School accounts, applications, career plans, opinions and connected future-focused texts

lessons.title: Learning Institutions and Stages of Education
lessons.focus: Describe and compare educational settings and routes.

lessons.title: The Classroom and Learning Tools
lessons.focus: Explain classroom routines, resources and effective learning environments.

lessons.title: Subjects, Timetables and Preferences
lessons.focus: Interpret timetables and justify subject preferences precisely.

lessons.title: Studying, Exams and Learning Strategies
lessons.focus: Discuss preparation, difficulties, progress and advice for successful study.
lessons.grammar: Verbal nouns; advice; إنّ and كان

lessons.title: Training, Qualifications and Skills
lessons.focus: Describe learning pathways, qualifications and transferable skills.

lessons.title: Jobs and Professions
lessons.focus: Identify, describe and compare a broad range of roles and responsibilities.

lessons.title: The Workplace and Working Conditions
lessons.focus: Discuss workplaces, schedules, pay, conditions, advantages and challenges.

lessons.title: Personal Qualities and Professional Skills
lessons.focus: Match strengths and qualities to roles and support judgements with evidence.

lessons.title: Applications and Interviews
lessons.focus: Interpret adverts, prepare an application and respond appropriately in an interview.
lessons.grammar: Formal questions; past experience; object pronouns

lessons.title: Career Plans, Ambitions and Choices
lessons.focus: Explain ambitions and evaluate how choices may shape the future.

lessons.title: Topic D Integrated Communication Workshop
lessons.focus: Connect education, qualifications, employment and future plans across four skills.

lessons.title: Topic D Review and Four-Skills Assessment
lessons.arabic: مُرَاجَعَةُ المِحْوَرِ د وَتَقْيِيمُ المَهَارَاتِ الأَرْبَعِ
lessons.focus: Demonstrate secure education and work language in varied assessment contexts.

practice.title: Education-system comparison
practice.text: Sort institutions and stages into a learner journey, then compare two education systems or school types using facilities, rules and opportunities.

practice.title: Classroom bag detective
practice.text: Describe learning tools without naming them. Partners identify each object, say where it is used and add one classroom instruction involving it.

practice.title: Timetable puzzle
practice.text: Reconstruct a school timetable from clues, then discuss favourite and difficult subjects with reasons and one comparison.

practice.title: Revision-strategy ranking
practice.text: Rank revision methods from most to least useful, justify the order and give targeted advice to a student preparing for an exam.

practice.title: Qualification route map
practice.text: Match courses, training and qualifications to future roles, then explain one complete route from school to further study or employment.

practice.title: Jobs taboo
practice.text: Describe a profession through duties, workplace and skills without saying its name. Partners identify it and state one advantage or disadvantage.

practice.title: Workplace comparison
practice.text: Compare two workplaces by hours, environment, responsibilities and conditions, then decide which suits a given worker profile best.

practice.title: Candidate skills match
practice.text: Match personal qualities and professional skills to different jobs. Every match must be justified with evidence from a short candidate profile.

practice.title: CV-to-interview challenge
practice.text: Match a vacancy to a candidate profile, select the strongest evidence for an application and role-play two interview questions and answers.

practice.title: Career pathway pitch
practice.text: Present a future study/work plan with ambitions, qualifications and reasons, then answer a partner question about an alternative route.

practice.title: Vacancy case study
practice.text: Combine a job advert, applicant profile, timetable and interview note. Decide whether the candidate should be shortlisted and defend the decision.

practice.title: Topic D four-skills relay
practice.text: Rotate through education, study, jobs and careers. Use evidence in listening/reading and produce one spoken and one written response before self-assessing.

e.title: The International World
e.summary: Countries, nationalities and languages, culture, customs, faiths and celebrations — explored through respectful comparison, identity and international communication.
subtopics: Countries, nationalities and languages in international and multilingual contexts
Culture and customs: identity, hospitality, etiquette and traditions
Faiths and celebrations: beliefs, places of worship, festivals and special occasions
grammar: Nisba adjectives and accurate country/nationality/language agreement
Relative pronouns and cohesive description of customs and beliefs
Past, present and future time frames for traditions and celebrations
Comparison, contrast and respectful expressions of viewpoint
Passive voice and verbal nouns in formal cultural texts
Question development and spontaneous interaction across familiar topics

skills.Listening: Travel interviews, cultural accounts, festival reports and multilingual conversations
skills.Reading: Profiles, cultural articles, invitations, reports and descriptions of traditions
skills.Speaking: Discuss language identity, compare customs and sustain respectful topic conversations
skills.Writing: Cultural descriptions, comparisons, experiences, invitations and extended reflections

lessons.title: Countries, Nationalities and Languages
lessons.focus: Locate countries and describe nationality, residence and language accurately.

lessons.title: Multilingual Life and Communication
lessons.focus: Discuss language learning, use, identity and communication across communities.
lessons.grammar: Present tense; verbal nouns; relative clauses

lessons.title: Culture and Personal Identity
lessons.focus: Explain how language, family, place and experience contribute to identity.

lessons.title: Customs, Etiquette and Hospitality
lessons.focus: Understand and compare courteous behaviour and hospitality traditions.

lessons.title: Faiths, Beliefs and Places of Worship
lessons.focus: Use respectful factual language to understand and describe familiar faith contexts.

lessons.title: Faith Celebrations and Special Occasions
lessons.focus: Describe the purpose, practices and personal meaning of celebrations.
lessons.grammar: Past and present; sequencing; object pronouns

lessons.title: National Festivals and Traditions
lessons.focus: Interpret reports and compare how communities mark important events.

lessons.title: Travel, Cultural Exchange and Understanding
lessons.focus: Explain how travel and exchange can broaden knowledge and challenge assumptions.
lessons.grammar: Past experience; future; cause and result

lessons.title: Comparing Cultures with Respect
lessons.focus: Compare similarities and differences without stereotypes or overgeneralisation.

lessons.title: International Life and Global Connections
lessons.focus: Connect language, culture, education, work, travel and global responsibility.

lessons.title: Topic E Integrated Communication Workshop
lessons.focus: Sustain spontaneous and connected communication across international contexts.
lessons.grammar: Mixed tenses; register; cohesion and accuracy

lessons.title: Topic E Review and Bridge to Final Revision
lessons.arabic: مُرَاجَعَةُ المِحْوَرِ هـ وَالِانْتِقَالُ إِلَى المُرَاجَعَةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ
lessons.focus: Complete the topic assessment, diagnose gaps and move into Exam Skills Extension.

practice.title: Country–language map match
practice.text: Match countries, nationalities and languages on a map, then give location and identity clues for a partner to solve.

practice.title: Multilingual mingle
practice.text: Interview classmates about languages spoken, studied or used in different situations, then report similarities, differences and one communication challenge.

practice.title: Culture and identity layers
practice.text: Sort identity statements into personal, family, local, national or international influences, then explain how two influences can coexist.

practice.title: Customs and etiquette sort
practice.text: Classify greetings, hospitality and social behaviours by situation, then advise a respectful visitor what to do, avoid or ask about.

practice.title: Belief and place vocabulary match
practice.text: Match neutral vocabulary for faith, belief, community and places of worship to short factual descriptions, then compare two statements respectfully without making value judgements.

practice.title: Celebration planner
practice.text: Plan a special occasion using date, activities, food, clothing and greetings. A partner asks follow-up questions and checks the sequence of events.

practice.title: Festival comparison
practice.text: Compare two national or cultural festivals by purpose, customs and activities, then identify one similarity and one difference using respectful language.

practice.title: Respectful visitor role-play
practice.text: Solve a cultural-exchange scenario involving greeting, invitation or local custom. Ask rather than assume, then explain the most respectful response.

practice.title: Culture comparison Venn
practice.text: Organise shared and different practices in a Venn diagram, then turn the notes into a balanced comparison with similarity and contrast connectors.

practice.title: Global headline classification
practice.text: Sort international headlines by theme, identify the likely issue or viewpoint and connect one story to culture, society, environment or technology.

practice.title: International fair information gap
practice.text: Combine country, language, custom, festival and travel clues to prepare a short information stand, then answer questions from another group.

practice.title: Topic E four-skills relay
practice.text: Complete country/language, customs, celebration and international-issue stations, then identify the language needed for final revision.
